messages.author: Sumra Abbasi
messages.body:

the following issue
xmgrace test167-rmsd-without-center.rms
--> Broken or incomplete installation - read the FAQ!
early xmgrace was working properly, for the last 2 3 days I am facing this.
My system Info:
CentOS Linux 7
processor Intel® Core™ i7-9700K CPU @ 3.
60GHz × 8

messages.author: Tru Huynh
messages.body:
On Mon, Jul 13, 2020 at 03:07:36PM +0500, Sumra Abbasi wrote:
> Hello everyone
> When i try to visualize my rmsd graph generated using cpptraj i am facing
> the following issue
> xmgrace test167-rmsd-without-center.rms
> --> Broken or incomplete installation - read the FAQ!
> early xmgrace was working properly, for the last 2 3 days I am facing this.
> My system Info:
> CentOS Linux 7
> processor Intel® Core™ i7-9700K CPU @ 3.
60GHz × 8
I assume that you have installed xmgrace from the EPEL
repository? It's a known issue, not fixed yet
https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=1757678
https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=1750589
https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=1751353
...
rebuilding your own xmgrace version from source
is a possible workaround, ymmv.
Cheers
Tru
--

messages.author: Elvis Martis
messages.body:
Hi
Tru exactly pointed the problem with the method you have used to install
xmgrace.
Uninstall the yum version of xmgrace.
Download the source and compile it from source.
This will resolve your problem.
